clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking teaches budding adventurers that cooking is the fundamental cornerstone of establishing a camp in the wild. By learning the craft from Cook Tomas in Goldshire, travelers acquire the ability to build campfires and pitch their own wilderness camps.

For any adventurer braving the wilds of Azeroth, setting up camp begins with a reliable blaze. The quest Camping 101: Cooking instructs novice wanderers that culinary training is not merely about preparing hot meals; it is the vital foundation for survival in the wilderness. By mastering the cooking profession, travelers learn how to strike a proper campfire, turning an untamed clearing into a safe refuge.

New travelers in Elwynn Forest are sent to speak with Cook Tomas in Goldshire to learn the fundamentals of the craft. Upon receiving his instruction, adventurers gain the ability to establish basic wilderness camps. While initial camps are simple and hold limited furnishings, honing one's cooking proficiency unlocks larger fires, while other crafting disciplines offer further options to furnish and customize a campsite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
